recent_en: SCB (Sik Cheong Berhad) held its 3rd AGM on 18 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including a final single tier dividend of 0.30 sen per share for FY2026. The company also released its quarterly report for the period ended 30 June 2026. There was no recent news coverage.
notable_en: The 3rd AGM was held on 18 September 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Shareholders approved a final single tier dividend of 0.30 sen per share for FY2026.
